description: This Dart source file defines providers, models, and logic for quiz analytics within a Flutter application using Riverpod. It includes external dependencies, model classes for filters and KPIs, and several provider and notifier definitions for managing quiz analytics data and state.

classes.name: AnalyticsFilter
classes.description: Model representing a filter with start and end date range and an optional category for analytics queries.

classes.name: QuizKpis
classes.description: Model capturing key performance indicators for quizzes such as total attempts, average score, best score, completion rate, and recent attempts count.

classes.name: PerQuizStat
classes.description: Stores per-quiz statistics including attempts, last score, best score, average score, and completion status.

classes.name: QuizAnalytics
classes.description: Aggregates overall KPIs and detailed per-quiz statistics for analytics reporting.

classes.name: AnalyticsFilterNotifier
classes.description: A Riverpod notifier managing current analytics filter state, allowing preset, custom, and category updates.

classes.name: QuizAnalyticsRefresher
classes.description: A notifier used to trigger refreshes of quiz analytics, typically after data changes.

methods.name: setPresetDays
methods.description: Sets the filter to the last specified number of days.

methods.name: setCustomRange
methods.description: Sets the filter to a custom date range.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Updates the filter to a specific quiz category.

methods.name: _startOfDay
methods.description: Helper method to normalize a DateTime to the start of the day in UTC.

methods.name: _endOfDay
methods.description: Helper method to normalize a DateTime to the end of the day in UTC.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Method on QuizAnalyticsRefresher to trigger a refresh of analytics data.
